ledger.note: 399: the Kutai Martadipura kingdom begins. 'The Kutai Martadipura Kingdom (399-1635) was the earliest Hindu kingdom in the East Indies'; the yupa inscriptions of King Mulawarman are dated by script 'to the last half the 4th century'; the first ruler named is Kudungga, then his son Aswawarman 'founder of the dynasty'. The page gives the span, not a founding event.

notes: One page opened (the article has no infobox and is thin; budget 2-5). Cliopatria has no row for the early Hindu kingdom (its Kutai Kingdom row, 1648-1733, is the Kartanegara sultanate, dossier kutai-kingdom). Wikidata id not looked up (wikidata.org unreachable): null. The shape for the whole life is the one the kutai-kingdom dossier hands over in 1635; nothing dates any growth. Muara Kaman coordinates (0.2 S 116.72 E) are approximate. The page names the successor sultanate as founded 'around the end of the 13th century' at Tepian Batu and also 1300; the kutai-kingdom dossier starts in 1300. Gazetteer: Muara Kaman resolves; Kutai Lama (the 1300 core, on the lower Mahakam) is not in places.jsonl, as in the kutai-kingdom dossier.
